blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.user` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method updates a user. It sends a request to the
[Update User](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#users\_postusersid)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the user to update.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the user to update.

children.name: first_name
children.description: The first name of the user.

children.name: last_name
children.description: The last name of the user.

children.name: avatar_url
children.description: The URL of the user's avatar image.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the user.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the tax region.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.
